item.title: Donegal had the lowest median house price during 2025
item.description: Donegal had the lowest median housing price in the country last year according to the Central Statistics Office. In the county the median price for a home was €195,000. In the F92 Lifford area, the median house price climbed by 10%, from €159,000 to €175,000. item.title: 21% of probation releases in Donegal reoffended within a year
item.description: 21% of people who were released on probation in Donegal in 2021 reoffended within a year. According to CSO data, 89 people received probation orders that year. Nineteen of those were found to have committed a crime within 12 months.
